At Solbound, we're not just installing solar panels — we're rewiring the way the world thinks about energy. Every rooftop we transform, every megawatt we put back into the grid is a statement that clean energy isn't the future. It's right now.

My father founded this company 25 years ago, believing the sun is the most powerful resource we have. I grew up watching him build something from nothing. Today I have the privilege of leading what he started — and that's a responsibility I carry every single day.

Patti Fernandez
CEO, Solbound

Every megawatt we install starts long before a panel hits a rooftop. It starts with a permit, a site survey, a crew briefing, and a safety check. It starts with people doing unglamorous work with extraordinary precision. 

I run operations at Solbound, which means I obsess over the details so our teams in the field don't have to. Timelines, logistics, compliance, equipment — that's my world. And I wouldn't have it any other way. 

What makes this company different isn't just the technology. It's the 112 field engineers who show up every morning ready to do the work. My job is to make sure they have everything they need to do it well.

Solar energy is the fastest-growing industry on the planet. And Solbound is growing faster than the industry. 

That's not an accident. Every dollar we invest goes back into the ground — into new projects, better equipment, stronger teams. When I look at our numbers, I don't just see revenue and margins. I see 128 active projects. I see communities gaining energy independence. I see a company that is proving, quarter after quarter, that doing good and doing well are exactly the same thing. 

We closed Q1 up 31% year-on-year. We're not slowing down.

The A-Series offers tiered residential solar solutions designed to scale with home size and energy demand. Each series supports monocrystalline or polycrystalline panels, with different system sizes and estimated cost ranges.

  • A100: entry-level coverage for smaller homes
  • A200–A300: mid-range options for medium to larger homes
  • A400: premium coverage for very large homes

Note: Costs are estimates and vary by configuration, installer, and site conditions.

A100 series

Entry-level system designed for smaller homes with a 20 kW system size.

  • Typical home size: 1500–2200 sq ft
  • Panel types: Monocrystalline / Polycrystalline
  • Efficiency: 15–20% (Mono) / 13–16% (Poly)
  • Estimated cost: $16k–$30k (Mono) / $12k–$20k (Poly)

A200 series

Mid-range option built to cover increased demand in medium-sized homes with a 26 kW system size.

  • Typical home size: 2000–2800 sq ft
  • Panel types: Monocrystalline / Polycrystalline
  • Efficiency: 15–20% (Mono) / 13–16% (Poly)
  • Estimated cost: $20.8k–$39k (Mono) / $15.6k–$26k (Poly)

A300 series

Designed for larger homes, providing broader coverage with a 26 kW system size and higher overall installation cost.

  • Typical home size: 2800–3500 sq ft
  • Panel types: Monocrystalline / Polycrystalline
  • Efficiency: 15–20% (Mono) / 13–16% (Poly)
  • Estimated cost: $30.8k–$49k (Mono) / $20.6k–$32k (Poly)

A400 series

Premium solution for very large homes, offering the highest total cost range with a 26 kW system size.

  • Typical home size: 3500–5000 sq ft
  • Panel types: Monocrystalline / Polycrystalline
  • Efficiency: 15–20% (Mono) / 13–16% (Poly)
  • Estimated cost: $52k–$65k (Mono) / $38k–$50k (Poly)

Comparison (A100 vs A200 vs A300 vs A400)

Source: A-series Solar Panel Specification Comparison.

How to choose

  • Start with your home size and annual energy usage.
  • Compare Mono vs Poly based on efficiency needs and budget.
  • Confirm roof space and shading constraints before final sizing.

The A‑Series portfolio scales from an affordable starter system to a premium, maximum‑capacity setup. Choose the series that best matches your home size, energy goals, and expansion plans.

Comparison at a glance

Notes: A100 supports monocrystalline (15–20%) and polycrystalline (13–16%) panel options, with typical panel lifespan of 25–30 years (warranty varies by panel type). Higher series are positioned for increasing output and scalability.

A100 Series

The A100 Series is a small residential, roof‑mounted solar array designed for environmentally conscious homeowners with 1500–2200 sq ft homes. It emphasizes affordability, straightforward installation, and solid efficiency for first‑time solar adopters.

  • Best for: small households and limited roof space
  • Panel options: monocrystalline (15–20%) or polycrystalline (13–16%)
  • Typical lifespan: 25–30 years (warranty varies by panel type)

A200 Series

The A200 Series targets medium‑sized residential homes of 2000–2800 sq ft, offering higher capacity and flexibility than A100. It’s a balanced solution for homeowners who want stronger energy independence without moving into large‑system complexity.

  • Best for: growing household loads (for example, adding EV charging)
  • What’s different vs. A100: higher output and more expansion headroom
  • Common add‑ons: battery storage and inverter upgrades

A300 Series

The A300 Series is designed for large residential homes (2800–3500 sq ft) that need significantly higher generation capacity. It emphasizes performance and space efficiency for households with high consumption or partial off‑grid ambitions.

  • Best for: large homes with high electricity demand
  • Strength: improved performance density (more output per roof area)
  • Typical add‑ons: battery storage (common)

A400 Series

The A400 Series is the flagship residential offering for extra‑large homes (3500–5000 sq ft) and premium installations. It prioritizes maximum efficiency, long‑term ROI, and sustainability at scale for customers seeking top‑tier system performance.

  • Best for: premium installs and maximum self‑generation goals
  • Positioning: highest capacity and scalability in the portfolio
  • Common add‑ons: battery systems and advanced inverters

Company Product Overview

Our company delivers a comprehensive portfolio of residential solar solutions, designed to empower homeowners with energy independence, sustainability, and long-term value. Our A-Series product line—A100, A200, A300, and A400—caters to a wide range of home sizes and energy needs, ensuring every customer finds the right fit for their property and goals.

  • A100 Series: Entry-level, affordable solar for smaller homes

  • A200 Series: Balanced capacity for growing households

  • A300 Series: High-output systems for large homes

  • A400 Series: Flagship, maximum-capacity solutions for premium installations

Our Strengths in the Market

  • Environmental Leadership: Our solar panels work so hard at cutting carbon they deserve tiny capes. They turn sunshine into clean energy while Mother Earth gives you a proud thumbs‑up.
  • Energy Independence: Make your own electricity and feel like a superhero who escaped the clutches of the grid. Blackouts? Energy drama? Not your origin story.
  • Cost Savings: These panels pay for themselves in 5–10 years, then keep quietly saving you money like a very polite, very sunny roommate.
  • Increased Home Value: Solar panels are basically curb appeal with a brain. They make your home more attractive to buyers who like smart homes and smarter bills.
  • Comprehensive Support: From installation to maintenance to squeezing every last ray of sunshine for efficiency, we’ve got you covered—no confusing manuals, no summoning tech spirits required.

Our Product Portfolio: The A‑Series Solar Solutions ☀️

Our residential solar portfolio is designed to scale with homeowners’ needs—from first‑time solar adopters to premium, high‑capacity installations. The A‑Series product line (A100, A200, A300, and A400) offers a clear upgrade path, enabling customers to start at the right level today and grow their system over time as energy needs evolve.

Each solution is engineered to balance efficiency, cost, and long‑term value, while maintaining consistent quality, durability, and environmental impact across the entire portfolio.

A100 Series – Simple, Affordable Entry into Solar

The A100 Series is designed for smaller residential homes and homeowners who are new to solar energy. It prioritizes affordability, straightforward installation, and reliable performance, making it an ideal starting point for environmentally conscious households.

Key characteristics include support for both monocrystalline and polycrystalline panels, solid efficiency for everyday household consumption, and long panel lifespans of 25–30 years depending on configuration. The A100 provides a strong return on investment while keeping upfront complexity and costs manageable.

A200 Series – Balanced Performance for Growing Homes

The A200 Series targets medium‑sized homes with increasing energy demands, such as households adding electric vehicles or higher‑consumption appliances. It delivers a balanced mix of capacity, flexibility, and cost efficiency.

Compared to A100, the A200 offers higher output and more expansion headroom. Customers often choose this model when they want additional independence from the grid while retaining flexibility for future upgrades like battery storage or inverter enhancements.

A300 Series – High‑Output Systems for Large Residences

The A300 Series is engineered for large residential homes with significantly higher electricity consumption. It focuses on performance density—delivering more power per square meter of roof space—making it suitable for customers with ambitious self‑generation goals.

This series is commonly paired with battery storage and is well suited for households seeking partial off‑grid capability, improved resilience, and optimized long‑term energy production.

A400 Series – Flagship, Premium Solar at Scale

The A400 Series represents our flagship residential offering. It is designed for extra‑large homes and premium installations where maximum efficiency, scalability, and long‑term value are essential.

With advanced inverter options, high‑efficiency monocrystalline panels, and support for large battery systems, the A400 enables customers to maximize energy independence while achieving strong environmental and financial returns over the system’s lifespan.
A‑Series Comparison Overview

Our Strengths in the Market 💪

Clear Upgrade Path

Our A‑Series is designed as a coherent portfolio. Customers can clearly see how each system builds on the previous one, reducing decision complexity and future‑proofing their investment.

Proven Efficiency and Longevity

Across all series, panels are built for durability with lifespans of 25–30 years. High‑efficiency monocrystalline options ensure strong performance even where roof space is limited.

Balanced Cost and ROI

Our solutions emphasize long‑term value rather than short‑term gains. With incentives, energy bill reductions, and predictable performance, customers typically achieve return on investment within 5–10 years, while continuing to benefit for decades.

End‑to‑End Residential Focus

Our portfolio is purpose‑built for residential rooftops—optimizing installation, maintenance, and everyday usability for homeowners rather than adapting generic or commercial systems.

Sustainability Without Compromise 🌍

Environmental impact is core to every A‑Series system. Customers reduce reliance on fossil fuels, lower carbon emissions, and invest in renewable energy without sacrificing reliability or performance.
